text:
[Council File 26-0005-S202; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTIONS relative to removing the property at 1254 West Exposition Boulevard (Case Nos. 739459, 785619, 883841), Assessor I.D. No. 5037-013-007, from the Rent Escrow Account Program (REAP).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
APPROVE the Housing Department (LAHD) reports dated November 6, 2026, attached to the Council file, and ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTIONS removing the property at 1254 West Exposition Boulevard (Case Nos. 739459, 785619, 883841), Assessor I.D. No. 5037-013-007, from the REAP.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the LAHD. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Housing Department request to take 1254 West Exposition Boulevard out of the Rent Escrow Account Program.
